name: sparkline
purpose: Word-sized inline trend graphic (line or bars) for text, tables, and cards: a static svg role="img" with a generated accessible name summarizing count, first and last value, minimum, and maximum.
whenToUse: Showing the shape of a trend next to a number (KPI tiles, table cells, sentences).
Many small trends on one page (cheap to create, no layout reads).
whenNotToUse: When users need to read individual values: use Line Chart or Bar Chart (tooltips, keyboard, data table).
As the only source of important information.
responsive: Scales with its box through the SVG viewBox (preserveAspectRatio none, non-scaling strokes); default 6em x 1.5em, so it follows the text size.
rtl: direction rtl mirrors the time direction (first value at the right).
theme: Stroke and bars use color-chart-<color>; the zero baseline uses color-chart-axis. Forced colors use CanvasText.
security: The accessible name is set as an attribute value; SVG is built with createElementNS. No style attributes, no innerHTML.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.budget: < 1 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Hundreds of instances per page; one to a few hundred values each (bars create one rect per value).

limitations: Not interactive: no tooltip or keyboard access to individual values.
Min and max are not marked visually (only the last value).
antiPatterns: Using a sparkline without a label that says what it measures.
Relying on the sparkline for exact values.
